BiblicalUsage: Ground, soil, earth — adamah is the red earth man was made from and the ground that bears the curse. God "formed man of the dust of the ground"; then He said, "cursed is the ground for thy sake"; and to Cain, "the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood." The word holds creation, curse, and blood in one.
TheologicalSignificance: We are dust, and the ground itself bears the curse — I hold that as the plain reading. But the same ground that drank Abel's blood is the ground God promises to renew, and the whole creation waits for it.
